name: Quarrelsome
overview: Scripture warns against a quarrelsome spirit, highlighting that a wrathful person stirs up strife, while patience can calm disputes. Contention is likened to water let loose, urging believers to avoid the beginnings of quarrels before they escalate. The wise are honored for ceasing strife, whereas fools provoke it, and it is better to endure solitude than live amidst constant anger and contention. Removing scorners brings an end to reproach and strife, underscoring the call to pursue peace and restraint in speech and conduct.
